title: DPad: Efficient Diffusion Language Models with Suffix Dropout

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: A training-free inference method for diffusion language models that reduces redundant suffix attention through a sliding window and distance-based suffix dropout.
sections.textZh: DPad 是一种无需训练的扩散语言模型推理方法，通过滑动窗口和基于距离的后缀丢弃，减少后缀部分的冗余注意力计算。

sections.heading: Contributions (Project Lead)
sections.text: Led the project, proposed the suffix dropout technique to reduce interference from low-entropy suffix tokens, and independently developed the open-source codebase.
sections.textZh: 牵头项目，提出后缀丢弃方法，以减轻低熵后缀 token 的干扰，并独立开发开源代码。

sections.heading: Results
sections.text: Up to 61.4× speedup over vanilla diffusion language models at comparable accuracy on LLaDA and Dream, with compatible decoding optimizations.
sections.textZh: 在 LLaDA 和 Dream 上，结合其他解码优化，与原始扩散语言模型相比，在准确率相近的条件下最高实现 61.4 倍加速。

sections.heading: Highlights
sections.text: Received collaboration invitations from Ant Group, AMD, and Meta; covered by Synced (Jiqizhixin) and other technology media. The suffix dropout technique also informed improvements in diffusion language model training.
sections.textZh: 研究收到蚂蚁集团、AMD 和 Meta 的合作邀请，并获机器之心等科技媒体报道。后缀丢弃方法也为扩散语言模型训练的改进提供了思路。

titleZh: 通过后缀丢弃提升扩散语言模型推理效率

title: CROPHE: Cross-Operator Dataflow Optimization for Fully Homomorphic Encryption Accelerators

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: An FHE accelerator combining unified processing elements with cross-operator scheduling to address memory bottlenecks through resource sharing and spatial/temporal pipelining.
sections.textZh: CROPHE 将统一处理单元与跨算子调度结合，通过资源共享和时空流水化缓解全同态加密加速器的存储瓶颈。

sections.heading: Contributions
sections.text: Took over the project and progressively assumed leadership. Co-developed a memory-aware scheduler with loop reordering and tiling to reduce DRAM traffic and SRAM requirements; designed processing elements supporting forward/inverse NTT and MAC operations.
sections.textZh: 接手项目并逐步承担负责人工作。与团队共同开发存储感知调度器，通过循环重排和分块减少 DRAM 访问及 SRAM 需求；设计支持正逆 NTT 和 MAC 运算的处理单元。

sections.heading: Results
sections.text: Reported 1.77×–4.86× speedup over the state-of-the-art accelerator designs evaluated in the paper.
sections.textZh: 相较论文评测的现有加速器，速度提升 1.77 至 4.86 倍。

categoryZh: 计算机体系结构与硬件设计
titleZh: 面向全同态加密加速器的跨算子数据流优化

title: Spec2Doc2RTL: RTL Generation from Specification with Natural Language Representation

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: A two-stage framework that translates specifications into RTL through natural-language design documents, using hierarchical decomposition and iterative feedback.
sections.textZh: 一个两阶段框架，先将规格说明转为自然语言设计文档，再通过层次化任务分解与迭代反馈生成 RTL。

sections.heading: Contributions
sections.text: Contributed to recursive task decomposition and co-developed the open-source GPT-4 Turbo-based framework with iterative feedback for design-document and RTL generation.
sections.textZh: 参与递归任务分解方法的设计，与团队共同开发基于 GPT-4 Turbo 的开源框架，实现设计文档和 RTL 的迭代生成。

sections.heading: Results
sections.text: Achieved 78.8% zero-shot pass@1 on Revisiting VerilogEval versus 60.3% for GPT-4 Turbo (+18.5 percentage points); demonstrated RISC-V CPU and NTT generation.
sections.textZh: 在 Revisiting VerilogEval 上，零样本 pass@1 达到 78.8%，高于 GPT-4 Turbo 的 60.3%，提升 18.5 个百分点；还展示了 RISC-V CPU 和 NTT 的生成。

titleZh: 利用自然语言设计文档从规格说明生成 RTL

title: A Unified Vector Processing Unit for Fully Homomorphic Encryption

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: A unified FHE vector processing unit that supports NTT and automorphism operations through shared hardware and an efficient inter-lane network.
sections.textZh: 设计统一的全同态加密向量处理单元，通过共享硬件和高效的 lane 间互连支持 NTT 与自同构运算。

sections.heading: Contributions
sections.text: Contributed to decomposing automorphisms into shifts and designing the inter-lane permutation network; co-proposed the unified vector processing unit.
sections.textZh: 参与将自同构运算分解为移位操作，并设计 lane 间置换网络；与团队共同提出统一向量处理单元。

sections.heading: Results
sections.text: Up to 9.4× area and 6.0× power savings for the inter-lane network; up to 1.2× area and 1.1× power savings for the full vector unit, relative to the designs evaluated in the paper.
sections.textZh: 相较论文比较的设计，lane 间网络的面积最多降至原来的 1/9.4，功耗降至 1/6.0；完整向量单元的面积和功耗分别降至 1/1.2 与 1/1.1。

categoryZh: 计算机体系结构与硬件设计
titleZh: 面向全同态加密的统一向量处理单元

title: Zero-Shot Structure-Preserving Diffusion Model for High Dynamic Range Tone Mapping

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: A zero-shot HDR tone-mapping method that transfers a pretrained diffusion model to HDR inputs while preserving image structure, without paired HDR/LDR training data.
sections.textZh: 将预训练扩散模型用于 HDR 输入，无需成对的 HDR/LDR 训练数据，同时保持图像结构。

sections.heading: Contributions
sections.text: Evaluated tone-mapping quality using metrics including TMQI.
sections.textZh: 使用 TMQI 等指标评估色调映射质量。

titleZh: 用于高动态范围色调映射的零样本结构保持扩散模型
